name: Lilyhammer
description: After Frank The Fixer Tagliano testifies against his Mafia boss in New York, he enters the Witness Protection Program and makes an unusual demand: he wants to be set up with a new life in the Norwegian small town of Lillehammer or as he calls it, Lilyhammer.

videos.title: Reality Check
videos.overview: Frank becomes Norwegian citizen "Giovanni Henriksen," meets his neighbor the chief of police, and clashes with his new country's bureaucratic culture.

videos.title: The Flamingo
videos.overview: Frank falls for his language teacher Sigrid and opens a nightclub that's a big hit, but he draws unwanted attention from the police and a biker gang.

videos.title: Guantanamo Blues
videos.overview: Now a successful local businessman, Frank joins a lucrative real estate deal but his plans are thwarted by the police, who believe he's a terrorist.

videos.title: The Midwife
videos.overview: Sigrid learns some surprising news, Frank's deal sours when his partner's son converts to Islam, and Geir stumbles on a clue to Frank's identity.

videos.title: My Kind of Town
videos.overview: Frank has a fight over a baby carriage but makes a deal to exit his real estate investment; Frank's enemies get an unexpected lead on his location.

videos.title: Pack Your Lederhosen
videos.overview: Flush with cash, Frank buys a new penthouse and invites Sigrid to move in, while Geir's colleagues get bad news and Mafia hitmen arrive in Norway.

videos.title: The Babysitter
videos.overview: The police chief suspects Frank is the link between a murder and a mysterious beating; Frank beefs up security when he learns he's in jeopardy.

videos.title: Trolls
videos.overview: Frank's attempt to rescue Sigrid's son leads to a spectacular shoot out and a series of shocking revelations that change both his old and new lives.

videos.title: Millwall Brick
videos.overview: Torgeir's mishap with a moose and a Ferrari enrages a British thief; Frank is alarmed by his twins' proposed names; Jan makes a sweet business deal.

videos.title: Out of Africa
videos.overview: Frank hires a new chef through his refugee center - an acquisition that catches Torgeirs attention in more ways than one. The death of Duncan Hammer attracts both the police and his brothers crew - bringing them closer to Torgeir and Frank.

videos.title: Fiddler's Green
videos.overview: Frank attempts to resolve the English conflict with a bribe; Roar becomes the victim as the English plan their payback for Hammers death; The police get an interesting new applicant as Laila retires from her position as sheriff.

videos.title: The Black Toe
videos.overview: A robbery in Oslo inadvertently reveals Franks identity to the Norwegian National Security; A business opportunity arises as local entrepreneurs seek to make an investment in the Flamingo; Torgeir gets acquainted with the new local sheriff.

videos.title: The Island
videos.overview: Frank follows up on the Oslo robbery and recruits an old "friend" for help; Torgeir and Roars mother returns to Norway with a new man; Jan runs into some relationship troubles on his birthday.

videos.title: Special Education
videos.overview: Stanley's proposal to Torgeir's mother ends badly for all parties; Frank finally catches up with the Oslo thieves and retrieves his documents; After the refugee center shuts, Jan makes a grave mistake; Franks history still remains a threat.

videos.title: The Freezer
videos.overview: After acquiring a herd of reindeer, Frank gets the idea to start racing them; Delucci finds out that Robby covered for Frank, so Robby plans to have Delucci dethroned; Jans actions come back to haunt him and decides to seek asylum in Iraq.

videos.title: Ghosts
videos.overview: Frank goes back to NY to settle things with Aldo, with two unsuspected local friends.

videos.title: Tiger Boy
videos.overview: It's not a happy New Year for Frank, topped off by Jan Johansen's surprise and unwanted return. Meanwhile, Roar is in Rio de Janeiro to get married.

videos.title: Foreign Affairs
videos.overview: Frank and Torgeir head to Brazil to save Roar from his troubles with the law, and Jan has second thoughts about his murder confession.

videos.title: The Homecoming
videos.overview: Frank and Torgeir have managed to free Roar from the Brazilian jail but, back in Lillehammer, the Lithuanian gang is causing trouble.

videos.title: The Mind is Like a Monkey
videos.overview: There 20th Anniversary of the Lillehammer Olympics is coming up, and Torgeir get his childhood dream fullfilled, that he will jump in the opening ceremony. But has he really nerves to carry?

videos.title: Tommy
videos.overview: An ex-mobster on a book tour in Scandinavia is victim to an assassination attempt and soon after, Frank gets a bloody former acquaintance at his door.

videos.title: The Minstrel Boy
videos.overview: Frank appreciate having a powerful mafia man as Tommy in the gang. But Tommy is struggling to cope with the high cost in Norway and goes behind Frank's back to earn a living.

videos.title: The Funeral
videos.overview: Things look good for Jan until his new girlfriend has a fateful request. Roar signs Torgeir's life away. Tommy takes his betrayal up a notch.

videos.title: Loose Ends
videos.overview: The new addition to Tommy's crew shocks Frank and Torgeir. Chris vows to do anything to win back Sigrid. Frank vows to hunt down Jan.

language: Norwegian, English, Portuguese, Lithuanian, Nepali, Arabic
